summary: Senior Manager, Analytics Insights candidate with ~7 years advising institutional clients on analytics-led transformation across Moody's Analytics, EY, and Ortec Finance. Holds delegated sign-off authority on analytical outputs for client portfolios of $5-25bn per engagement and sits on a model governance committee. Builds Python and SQL analytics pipelines, stochastic simulation and optimization models, and agentic AI delivery workflows that cut development cycle time an estimated 30-40%. CFA, dual MSc.
core_skills: Executive & Stakeholder Communication (Heads of Risk, Investment Committees)
Agentic AI & Generative AI Delivery Workflows

sections.heading: Analytical Quality Assurance, Governance & Standards
bullets: Holds delegated sign-off authority on valuation, sensitivity, and ALM analytics delivered to institutional client portfolios of $5-25bn per engagement (~$50bn+ cumulative), independently reviewing quantitative methodology, calibration, and cross-asset interactions before production release.

Sits on the model governance committee, contributing to methodology review, documentation and benchmarking standards, and model-performance assessment across the lifecycle of client-delivered analytics.
Acts as escalation point for client-critical analytical issues, interfacing with clients' Heads of Risk, and holds back outputs lacking mathematical or economic defensibility.

sections.heading: Analytics Solution Design & Data Engineering
bullets: Led design and implementation of an enterprise multi-asset cash flow projection engine covering base, stress, and reverse-stress scenario simulation, giving clients forward-looking liquidity visibility.
Architected configurable time-bucketed gap analytics (T+1 through multi-year) enabling funding optimization, refinancing risk assessment, and asset-allocation decisions.
Re-engineered manual spreadsheet workflows into scalable Python analytics pipelines with embedded logging, validation, and auditability controls.

sections.heading: AI-Enabled Delivery & Executive Insight
bullets: Built agentic AI development workflows using generative AI tooling (Claude Code, Cursor IDE) that automate code generation, validation scaffolding, anomaly detection, and documentation, reducing development cycle time an estimated 30-40% on comparable modules.
Prepared analytical summaries for senior stakeholders on interest-rate exposure, scenario impacts, and balance-sheet sensitivities, translating quantitative output into decision-ready narratives.

Led onboarding and implementation for U.S. and Canadian pension funds, asset managers, and consulting firms migrating to the PFaroe DB (risk & ALM analytics) and PFaroe PM (portfolio management) platforms.
Translated ambiguous investment-team requirements into scoped Product Owner development requests as technical liaison, advising on configuration and validating model outputs post-deployment.
Contributed to migrating all assigned client accounts from the legacy Calypso environment to PFaroe PM.

roles.title: Senior Consultant - IFRS & Financial Risk Transformation

bullets: Delivered IFRS 17 and IFRS 9 technology-transformation programs for Canadian and international insurance clients, aligning reporting requirements with system implementation.
Advised actuarial, IT, finance, and program-management stakeholders on standard adoption and contributed to governance documentation and regulatory-readiness processes.
Developed IFRS 17 advisory product offerings and go-to-market collateral supporting practice growth, and coordinated cross-functional teams on milestone delivery.
Delivered ALM and investment studies for Canadian and international pension funds and institutional investors, analysing funding ratios, duration mismatch, and long-term balance-sheet exposures.
Built and interpreted stochastic economic scenario generators quantifying interest-rate and funding-volatility risk under base-case and stressed environments.

Performed asset-only and asset-liability portfolio optimization on VaR and CVaR using Ortec's GLASS platform, with risk decomposition and near-optimal frontier analysis to test the robustness of recommendations.
Presented study findings and strategic asset-allocation recommendations on-site to investment committees at pension-fund clients.
Led onboarding and the ALM study for a three-plan university pension merger on a team of three, developing and validating the model capturing all Funding Policy dynamics.

education: MSc, Chemical Engineering (Full Scholarship) - Western University, 2016
